notes: Synthetic: from Mistral's official SDK, github.com/mistralai/client-python at 90e300904b64c36e0630f72ef475dbab7912068e (2026-10-28), whose models are generated by Speakeasy from Mistral's OpenAPI spec, POST /v1/audio/speech (speech.py, operation speech_v1_audio_speech_post): SpeechRequest (input, model, voice_id, response_format pcm|wav|mp3|flac|opus, stream; no voice) and the non-stream 200, application/json SpeechResponse {audio_data: base64}, gap MI4. The model, the voice_id and audio_data are the SDK's realtime speech test's (extra/tests/test_realtime_speech.py: MODEL voxtral-mini-tts-3, voice_id my-voice, AUDIO_DELTA's audio_data "AAAAAA==", 4 bytes of PCM silence); the input is a placeholder. The stream variant (text/event-stream speech.audio.delta / speech.audio.done) is not driven: models.SpeechRequest has no stream field, so the gateway never asks for it. error_invalid_model is the error body of the SDK's test_error_response (extra/tests/test_otel_tracing.py) verbatim, status 400 as there: the API error body the SDK's error hook reads (extra/observability/otel.py), gap MI1. The operation types no other 4XX body. Mistral's spec itself (Speakeasy registry, docs.mistral.ai) was not reachable from the authoring sandbox.
